desktop_only: Available only in the desktop app.
preferences_language_desc: The language orCAL is shown in.
preferences_language_hint: Results follow it too: French writes 3,5 for 3.5.
preferences_startup_layout_desc: Takes effect the next time orCAL starts.
preferences_about_desc: A calculator with a phone keypad and a scientific tablet layout, from Project Colony.
preferences_about_fonts_desc: JetBrains Mono Nerd Font and OpenDyslexic, under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
settings_appearance_desc: Adjust the theme, accents, text and visual effects.
settings_accessibility_desc: Make the interface easier to see, read and use.
settings_theme_desc: Applies immediately to the whole interface.
settings_colors_desc: Pick an accent, or keep the one the theme was designed with.
settings_auto_accent_desc: Uses the theme's own accent instead of the one picked above.
settings_typography_desc: The interface font and its base size.
settings_font_family_desc: Switches to OpenDyslexic when the dyslexia-friendly font is on.
settings_font_size_desc: Base size of every text in the interface.
settings_effects_desc: Visual extras. Always off while Reduce motion is on.
settings_preview_desc: A live sample of your current choices.
settings_vision_desc: Options that make the interface easier to see.
settings_high_contrast_desc: Increases the contrast of text and borders.
settings_dyslexia_font_desc: Replaces the interface font with OpenDyslexic.
settings_reduce_motion_desc: Turns off every animation and transition.
settings_text_size_a11y_desc: Scales all text. Multiplies with the size chosen in Appearance.
